issues.explanation: 茶園 is a common noun here, not a proper name.
最後 means “last” or “final”; “last time” is the meaning of 最後に会った時 as a larger phrase.
The contextual reading of the inflected surface is あった, not the lemma reading あう.
The contextual reading of the past form is した, not dictionary-form kana する.
The annotation has no grammar overlay for the temporal/conditional と construction in 尋ねると.
issues.suggested_fix: Add an overlay spanning exactly "尋ねると" or the larger exact construction "どうしたのかと尋ねると".

issues.explanation: If treated as the character’s name, “Kuro” is appropriate, but the annotation should distinguish this proper-name use from the ordinary noun meaning “black.”
issues.suggested_fix: Retain type name only if character-name metadata is intended; otherwise use word with meaning "black".

issues.explanation: This fixed expression literally refers to a weasel’s final discharge and figuratively to a last-ditch final act; “stink bomb” is overly paraphrastic.
issues.suggested_fix: Use meaning_en "a weasel’s final fart; last-ditch final act".

issues.explanation: The contextual reading of the past form is こたえた, not the lemma reading こたえる.
赤松 refers to red pine trees in this scene, not a proper name.
The contextual reading is みえていた, including the aspectual inflection.
見える plus the aspectual auxiliary いる and past auxiliary た is ordinary compositional grammar and should not be represented as one undifferentiated word.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate the verb and auxiliaries, or retain exact morphological segments and add an aspect/past overlay spanning "見えていた".

issues.explanation: The conjunctive form reads ちり, not the dictionary-form reading ちる.
花弁 is a different, formal lexical item; it is not the appropriate lemma for the surface 花びら.
issues.suggested_fix: Use lemma "花びら" with kana "はなびら".

issues.explanation: The negative auxiliary ず is compositional and should be separately annotated rather than absorbed into 残す.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate the verb stem from ず, or add an exact negative-auxiliary overlay spanning "残さず".

issues.explanation: The contextual reading is のこさず, not the dictionary-form reading のこす.
The contextual reading is おちた, not the dictionary-form reading おちる.
The inflected adverbial form reads はやく, not はやい.
The conjunctive form reads かたむき, not the dictionary-form reading かたむく.
The negative auxiliary ない is ordinary compositional grammar and should be separately annotated.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate the verb stem and ない, or add an exact negative overlay spanning "吹かない".

issues.explanation: The contextual reading is ふかない, not the dictionary-form reading ふく.
The te-form ending て should be separately represented as the connective particle/ending rather than folded into the verb entry.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate the verb form and て, or add an exact te-form overlay spanning "なって".

issues.explanation: The contextual reading is なって, not the dictionary-form reading なる.
In 稀に, に is the adverbial inflection of the na-adjective 稀, not an independent case particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate 稀に as the adverbial form of 稀 or classify に as the appropriate inflectional auxiliary/ending.

issues.explanation: The temporal construction 〜てから (“after becoming”) is not represented by any grammar overlay.
issues.suggested_fix: Add an overlay spanning exactly "なってから".

issues.explanation: This contains the verb 狭める, passive auxiliary られる, and past auxiliary た; these are ordinary compositional elements.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate the passive and past auxiliaries, or add exact passive and past overlays spanning "狭められた".

issues.explanation: The contextual reading is せばめられた, not the dictionary-form reading せばめる.
ような is the attributive form of the auxiliary/expression ようだ, not an ordinary standalone word in this construction.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate it as the appropriate auxiliary/adjectival grammatical form.

issues.explanation: The surface reading is ような, not dictionary-form ようだ.
The fixed evidential/subjective construction ような気がする (“have the feeling that…”) is absent from the grammar overlays.
issues.suggested_fix: Add an overlay spanning exactly "ような気がする".

issues.explanation: The continuative form reads いき, not the dictionary-form reading いく.
The conditional ば element should be separately annotated from 来る under the requested word/auxiliary/particle splitting.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate the conditional element, or add an exact conditional overlay spanning "来れば".

issues.explanation: The contextual reading is くれば, not the dictionary-form reading くる.
